title: Chemical similarity to training drugs
original_agent_determination: No meaningful decline. HVG overlap@N was 0.013 higher in the least-similar bin than in the most-similar bin.

title: Dose represented in training
original_agent_determination: The agent plotted dose as an exploratory protocol diagnostic and rejected it as a decreasing training-similarity axis because every dose level was represented in training. This entry retains that original curve and rejection.

title: Reactome pathway-set similarity
original_agent_determination: Above versus at or below 0.5 Jaccard similarity, overlap@N fell from 0.272 to 0.176 (HVG) and from 0.219 to 0.134 (SE).
